name: Convocatoria de Proyectos Socioambientales (BPCR)

funder.name: Banco de Proyectos Comunitarios Rurales (Red Comunidades Rurales)

summary: Periodic calls giving grants to rural community organisations and their supporting groups across eight Argentine ecoregions. Themes include conservation, remediation and regeneration of natural environments alongside water, food and livelihood projects.

amount.note: Two categories: up to ARS 5,000,000 or up to ARS 10,000,000
